visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with brown hair, wearing a black pleated zip-up jacket, stands in a brightly lit studio with blurry monitors in the background; he speaks directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures. (2) A transition reveals the famous Japanese woodblock print 'The Great Wave off Kanagawa' centered on a cream-colored textured background. (3) The imagery shifts through various applications of the wave art: a version with the character Tanjiro from Demon Slayer, a new Japanese 1000 Yen banknote, and finally a specialized MSI laptop with the wave design on the lid. (4) The speaker returns to the screen, continuing his explanation with a focus on his upper body and moving hands against the studio backdrop. (5) A montage of diverse Ukiyo-e prints is displayed, including a censored erotic scene, a fierce-looking Kabuki actor's portrait, and a dynamic illustration of people in a violent conflict near water.
